prompt: List all droplets in our DigitalOcean account.

steps.content: api error: GET https://api.digitalocean.com/v2/droplets?page=1&per_page=200: 401 (request "487f0290-54d6-40c8-8ff4-8974a6dcd66e") Unable to authenticate you
steps.name: digitalocean__droplet-list

steps.text:
I couldn't list the droplets. DigitalOcean rejected the request with **401 Unauthorized ("Unable to authenticate you")**.

- **Call:** `GET https://api.digitalocean.com/v2/droplets?page=1&per_page=200`
- **Request ID:** `487f0290-54d6-40c8-8ff4-8974a6dcd66e`

DigitalOcean didn't accept the API token the integration is using. It may be missing, expired, revoked or wrong. Trying again won't help until the token is fixed. Someone with access to the DigitalOcean account needs to issue a new API token or reconfigure the existing one, with at least read access to droplets. Once that's done, I can run the list again. If you open a ticket with DigitalOcean, include the request ID above.
